operations.label: Runtime raster-filter integration gap detected
operations.evidence: The standalone raster guard passed preflight tests, but the downloaded TIFF value array was not yet guaranteed to use the official EA NoData sentinel filter at measurement runtime.

operations.label: Fail-closed runtime guard injector implemented
operations.evidence: A slot-scoped Python injector adds guarded carrier patches for classic TIFF header validation and official EA NoData filtering on the real raster value array.

operations.label: Runtime guard injector deterministic test completed
operations.evidence: Local deterministic checks covered duplicate markers, both TIFF endiannesses, sentinel insertion and task-version upgrade.

operations.label: Hash-bound runtime carrier handoff implemented
operations.evidence: The entry wrapper verifies injector state, patch labels, source/output identity and SHA-256 before executing the patched carrier.

operations.label: Historical shared-runner queue branch rechecked
operations.evidence: Remote branch search again returned no codex/aays-single-runner-v5-20260706 reference; task remains prepared_not_enqueued and no queue mutation was made.

operations.label: Current HMLR identity and projection contract revalidated
operations.evidence: Official HMLR pages still define a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID per polygon, native British National Grid data and an up-to-15m BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection warning; July 2026 publication remains current.

operations.label: Generic polygon identifier fallback risk detected
operations.evidence: The resolver could select a generic id or gml_id column when an INSPIRE-semantic field was absent, risking promotion of a technical identifier instead of the Land Registry-INSPIRE identity.

operations.label: INSPIRE-semantic identifier receipt gate implemented
operations.evidence: The runtime carrier now requires the HMLR receipt identifier-column name to contain both INSPIRE and ID semantics; generic id and gml_id alone fail closed.

operations.label: HMLR identifier count and digest gates implemented
operations.evidence: PowerShell independently requires positive feature_count, unique_identifier_count equal to feature_count and a 64-character identifier-set SHA-256.

operations.label: Runtime injector v1.1 deterministic verification completed
operations.evidence: Equivalent local committed-logic test passed 13/13, including duplicate main marker and duplicate HMLR receipt marker rejection.

operations.label: Task v1.12 and receipt handoff aligned
operations.evidence: Prepared task contains 48 fail-closed checks; entry wrapper verifies injector version, three labels, source/output paths, byte counts and SHA-256 before execution.
